verdict.rationale: Segment documents its own Consent Management feature for enforcing end-user consent preferences. The docs say users set preferences about the data they want collected, used, and shared, and that consent stored in the data warehouse can be enforced. However, the evidence does not show how consent categories map to destinations or that opt-outs are automatically blocked from flowing downstream. Missing for 10: documented per-destination consent-category routing, explicit automatic opt-out enforcement downstream, details on capture mechanisms (e.g., CMP integration), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically

citations.quote: Segment recommends using Consent Management to enforce end-user preferences related to cookies and data collection consent
When an end user visits your web or mobile app, they set **consent preferences**, or make decisions about the types of data they want you to collect, use, and share.
Enforce consent preferences stored in your data warehouse.

Segment includes a suite of privacy tools to help your organization comply with regulations like the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
